examples.condition: Latest FeatureServer and hosted-table fields must be mapped explicitly; case and data types are not interchangeable.
A FeatureServer query exceeding 2,000 records must be paged; truncation cannot be treated as completeness.
A hosted-table query exceeding 1,000 records must be paged independently from the centroid service.
The hosted table has no geometry and cannot be used as a postcode centroid geometry source.
PCD7, PCD8 and PCDS values require normalized exact equality before rows are reconciled.
A non-empty DOTERM value must remain terminated and cannot silently be treated as a live postcode.
DOINTR and the pinned release date must be retained to prevent time-inconsistent joins.
GRIDIND must be interpreted as a quality indicator; a one-metre field name does not guarantee parcel accuracy.
EPSG:27700 easting/northing values must not be interpreted as longitude/latitude.
ONS LAT/LONG describes a postcode reference position and not a parcel or title centroid.
Service edit timestamps must be stored separately from the May 2026 data snapshot.
The 4 June 2026 SSR95CD correction must be pinned; an earlier May package cannot be silently mixed.
A 12-digit UPRN must be preserved without floating-point conversion or scientific notation.
OS Open UPRN includes all lifecycle states, so product presence alone cannot prove that an address is current.
A British National Grid UPRN point cannot substitute for an HMLR title polygon.
An HMLR INSPIRE polygon is an indicative registered freehold extent and not a guaranteed legal boundary.
Duplicate INSPIRE polygons across local-authority files require stable identifier and geometry-hash review.
A possible 15 m WGS84 transformation shift forbids exact title assignment from reprojected proximity alone.
